description: The one shape the schema cannot turn away. `packages` and `modules` are both optional — requiring both would make a project that colors only ambient modules write an empty `packages` to say nothing with, and the schema's grammar has no way to ask for one of two — so a table misspelled `packagez` validates and is read as no table at all. Reporting that file as absent would tell its author there is nothing there, so `check` names it instead: the file was read, and neither table it reads was in it. Not a refusal — there is nothing here being ignored, only nothing here — so it still exits 0.

names:
nothrow.overrides.json
  it names neither `packages` nor `modules`, so it asserts nothing. Those are the two tables read; a key spelled any other way is not one of them.
